name: Vaud
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Vaud
summary: White over green with the motto 'LIBERTÉ ET PATRIE' (Freedom and Fatherland) in gold on the white. Green was the colour of the 1798 Vaudois revolution.
origin: Vaud was ruled by Bern until the Vaudois revolution of 1798, which used green as its colour. It became a canton in 1803.
facts: Lausanne, home of the International Olympic Committee, is its capital.
Its green comes from the revolution against Bernese rule.
clues: White over green with a French motto in gold.
Its canton freed itself from Bernese rule in 1798.
Home of the International Olympic Committee.
